blurb: Guests can enjoy award-winning wines, dine at the on-site restaurant, and participate in events such as grape stomps and wine club parties. The vineyard offers scenic views, live music, and a variety of wine-related experiences including kayak and tubing trips, horseback rides, and jeep tours. Group outings and private events are also accommodated.
